sources.entry: KeyHolder - Record shortcuts in macOS, like Alfred.app.

summary.one_liner: KeyHolder is a macOS Swift library that provides a RecordView control for recording keyboard shortcuts, similar to the shortcut recorder in Alfred.app.
use_cases: Let users record a custom keyboard shortcut in a macOS app's preferences
Set a default key combination in a Swift control
Support double-tap modifier shortcuts such as double Command
Clear or change an existing shortcut through delegate callbacks or closures
Build hotkey settings UI on top of Magnet and Sauce
how_to_run: Add KeyHolder as a dependency (the README does not give exact install steps)
Implement RecordViewDelegate methods or set recordView.didChange closure
notable: RecordView control for capturing key combinations
Supports double-modifier combos like doubled Command via KeyCombo(doubledModifiers:)
Offers both delegate methods and closure-based change callbacks
Built on the Magnet and Sauce hotkey libraries
caveats: README is brief; no installation instructions or API docs beyond short examples
Depends on the Magnet and Sauce libraries
